key_moments: Goal: Kerim Alajbegovic opens scoring for Bosnia & Herzegovina (29').
Own Goal: Sultan Al-Brake deflects a shot into his own net, doubling Bosnia's lead (34').
Goal: Hassan Al Haydos pulls one back for Qatar before halftime (42').
Post Hit: Edin Dzeko's shot strikes the post, denying Bosnia a third goal (39').
Injury: Qatar captain Hassan Al Haydos is substituted due to injury (56').
Goal: Ermin Mahmic secures Bosnia's victory with a late goal (80').

standout_performers.reason: Scored the opening goal and was instrumental in creating chances.
Provided a key assist and maintained a high tempo with accurate passing.
Scored Qatar's only goal and led the team as captain before his injury.

matches.tactical_summary: Bosnia & Herzegovina dictated possession and built attacks methodically, aiming to break down Qatar's defense with structured play. Qatar, in turn, sought to exploit counter-attacking opportunities and created high-quality chances despite less possession.

narrative: Bosnia & Herzegovina secured a vital 3-1 victory over Qatar in Kansas City, keeping their hopes of advancing to the knockout stages alive. This result, achieved through a combination of structured play and a late insurance goal, eliminates Qatar from the tournament.
